g.text: Hierarchical Multi-Scale Asymmetry-Aware Transformer with Evidential Clinical Uncertainty & Dense FPN Segmentation
Stage 3: Bilateral Symmetry Attention (S-MHSA, L = 4, H = 8)
Compares mirrored spatial coordinates across interhemispheric sagittal fissure:
Mirror Coordinate: x_sym = (r, W - 1 - c) ↔ Asymmetry Gate: G_asym
S-MHSA = Softmax((Q · K^T)/√d + G_asym ⊙ Mirror(Q · K^T)) · V
Feature Map: F₃ ∈ ℝ^(256 × 14 × 14) — Asymmetry-Enhanced Lesion Embeddings
Resolution: 7 × 7 | Hidden Dimension: 512 | Macro-Semantic Anatomical Context
ℒ_evidential = (1 - p_t)^γ · ℒ_ACE(α, y) + λ_KL(t) · ℒ_KL(α̃ || 1)
• Focal Modulation (γ = 1.5): Forces gradient focus on hard borderline tumors
• Annealed KL Divergence: Prevents false confident evidence on negative controls
• Soft Dice: Maximizes spatial overlap on micro-lesions (<3% area)
• Focal BCE (γ = 2.0): Eliminates pixel imbalance between tumor and brain tissue
• Evaluated conditionally only on slices with expert radiologist masks
